issues.description: The template defines the QFT function with a leading underscore (_qft_circuit_n_qubits) while the solution and problem statement use qft_circuit_n_qubits (no underscore). This identifier mismatch will confuse students about which method to implement and may cause automated tests or graders to look for a different method name than what students implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method from _qft_circuit_n_qubits to qft_circuit_n_qubits to match the problem statement and solution (remove the leading underscore). Ensure the inverse method name remains qft_circuit_n_qubits_inverse so student implementations and tests align.
